# SETUP AND LOAD LIBRARIES

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)
library(AUCell)
library(pheatmap)
```

# LOAD INTEGRATED AND CLUSTERED DATA

```{r}
INPUT_OBJECT_PATH <- "data/processed/combined_integrated_clustered.rds"
SAVE_OBJECT_PATH <- "data/processed/combined_marker_genes_annotated.rds"

if (!file.exists(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)) {
  stop("ERROR: Integrated and clustered object not found. Run 04_integration_clustering.Rmd first!")
}
singlets <- readRDS(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)
DefaultAssay(singlets) <- "SCT"
print(paste("Loaded clustered object with", ncol(singlets), "nuclei."))
```

# LOAD AND PREPARE MARKER GENES

```{r}
# Load the semi-colon delimited marker gene file
marker_df <- read.csv(MARKER_FILE_PATH, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ";")

# Convert the dataframe into a named list of gene sets
# 1. Select the required columns.
# 2. Split the comma-separated genes.
# 3. Group by cell type name.
# 4. Create the final named list.

marker_list <- marker_df %>%
select(`major.cell.type.names`, `defining.marker.genes`) %>%
distinct() %>%
group_by(`major.cell.type.names`) %>%
summarize(genes = list(unique(unlist(str_split(`defining.marker.genes`, ","))))) %>%
{ setNames(.$genes, .$`major.cell.type.names`) }

print(paste("Loaded", length(marker_list), "marker gene sets."))
```

# METHOD 1: Seurat Module Scoring for Annotation

```{r}
# Calculate Module Scores
for (cell_type in names(marker_list)) {
genes <- intersect(marker_list[[cell_type]], rownames(singlets))
# Note: AddModuleScore automatically appends '1' to the column name
singlets <- AddModuleScore(
 singlets,
 features = list(genes),
 name = paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", cell_type))
)
}

# Determine the top two cell types based on module score per cluster
clusters <- singlets$seurat_clusters
cluster_scores <- data.frame()

for (cell_type in names(marker_list)) {
score_col <- paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", cell_type), "1")
mean_scores <- tapply(singlets@meta.data[[score_col]], clusters, mean)
cluster_scores <- rbind(cluster_scores, data.frame(cluster = names(mean_scores), cell_type = cell_type, avg_score = as.numeric(mean_scores)))
}

# Assign labels
cluster_label_top2 <- cluster_scores %>%
group_by(cluster) %>%
arrange(desc(avg_score)) %>%
mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
filter(rank <= 2) %>%
ungroup()

cluster_labels_named_1st <- cluster_label_top2 %>% filter(rank == 1) %>% select(cluster, cell_type) %>% deframe()

# Add labels to Seurat metadata
singlets$top_celltype_label <- cluster_labels_named_1st[as.character(singlets$seurat_clusters)]
```

## Visualization of Module Score Labels

```{r}
Idents(singlets) <- singlets$top_celltype_label

p1 <- DimPlot(singlets, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.5, raster = FALSE) +
ggtitle("UMAP colored by Top Cell Type Label (ModuleScore)")

# Calculate cluster centers for labeling
umap_coords <- Embeddings(singlets, "umap")
clusters_id <- as.character(singlets$seurat_clusters)
umap_centers <- aggregate(umap_coords, by = list(cluster = clusters_id), FUN = mean)
colnames(umap_centers)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

# Overlay cluster numbers
p1 <- p1 + geom_text(
data = umap_centers,
aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
size = 4,
color = "black"
)
print(p1)
ggsave("plots/05_umap_marker_top1.png", p1, height = 7, width = 10)
```

# METHOD 2: AUCell for Gene Set Enrichment

```{r}
exprMat <- GetAssayData(singlets, assay = "SCT", slot = "data")

# Build rankings
cells_rankings <- AUCell_buildRankings(exprMat, nCores=1, plotStats=FALSE)

# Calculate AUC scores
auc_scores <- AUCell_calcAUC(marker_list, cells_rankings, aucMaxRank = ceiling(0.05 * nrow(exprMat)))
auc_df <- as.data.frame(t(getAUC(auc_scores))) # cells × gene sets

# Make sure column names are valid for Seurat metadata
colnames(auc_df) <- make.names(colnames(auc_df), unique = TRUE)

singlets <- AddMetaData(singlets, metadata = auc_df)

# Calculate average AUC scores per cluster for plotting
# Need to use the new column names (post make.names) for selection
valid_auc_cols <- colnames(auc_df)

avg_auc <- singlets@meta.data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(valid_auc_cols), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}")) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "seurat_clusters") %>%
  t()
rownames(avg_auc) <- sub("mean_", "", rownames(avg_auc))
```

## Visualization of AUCell Results

```{r}
# DotPlot for AUC scores
Idents(singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"
p_auc_dot <- DotPlot(singlets, features = rownames(avg_auc), group.by = "seurat_clusters",
   dot.scale = 6, cols = c("lightgrey", "red")) +
RotatedAxis() +
labs(size = "Mean AUC Score", color = "Fraction of Cells") +
ggtitle("AUCell Gene Set Activity across Clusters") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p_auc_dot)

ggsave("plots/05_dotplot_AUC_gene_sets.png", plot = p_auc_dot, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# SAVE FINAL ANNOTATED OBJECT AND SUMMARY

```{r}
# Save cell cycle summary as CSV
cellcycle_summary <- singlets@meta.data %>%
 group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
 summarise(
  n_cells = n(),
  avg_S_score = mean(S.Score, na.rm = TRUE),
  avg_G2M_score = mean(G2M.Score, na.rm = TRUE),
  prop_S = mean(Phase == "S"),
  prop_G2M = mean(Phase == "G2M"),
  prop_G1 = mean(Phase == "G1")
 ) %>%
 rowwise() %>%
 mutate(dominant_phase = c("G1", "S", "G2M")[which.max(c(prop_G1, prop_S, prop_G2M))]) %>%
 ungroup() %>%
 arrange(as.numeric(as.character(seurat_clusters)))

write.csv(cellcycle_summary, file = "data/processed/cellcycle_summary_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Saving the final annotated Seurat object
saveRDS(singlets, SAVE_OBJECT_PATH)
print(paste("Step 5 (Marker Gene Annotation) Complete. Final annotated object saved to:", SAVE_OBJECT_PATH))
```
